about.title: About us
about.intro: InkSpills started with a simple question: why pay full price for a book you will only read once? We built a bookstore that lets you choose. Buy the books you want on your shelf for years, or rent the ones you need for a class, a trip or a single weekend.

buy.title: One clear price to buy
buy.body: Every book has a clear price to buy and keep. Your account lists everything you own under Purchased books.

rent.title: One weekly price to rent
rent.body: Rent by the week. Your account keeps track of what you are renting and when each rental ends.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: We want reading to be affordable and easy for everyone. Students, commuters and curious readers should be able to try more books without filling their shelves or emptying their wallets.
